correctness.rationale: For Zaidi–Jamil Γ-cubes, every J_2 radius-one hyperedge comprises three of four corners. Any square with three image values violates a source hyperedge, so each nondegenerate square uses exactly the endpoints of one target graph edge. Thus C2 and C1 decompose edgewise and ∂2 respects edge summands. On an edge all Γ-cubes are valid; coning along the last coordinate to a fixed endpoint, with sign (−1)^{n+1}, gives a normalized integral chain contraction in positive degrees. Consequently every global 2-cycle bounds using edge-supported 3-cubes: H2^Γ=0 integrally. ∂2 of a square with corner values (a,b,a,a) identifies opposite oriented arcs, giving H1 the ordinary graph cycle lattice and H0 components. Independently checked the signed cone identity on 232 single-edge nondegenerate cubes in degrees 0–3 and finite examples, not substituted for the universal contraction.
residual_risks: Graph assumed simple, finite, no isolated vertices; source conventions for Γ singular cubes are pivotal.
No assertion about H_n for n>=3 or a full chain-equivalence with ordinary graph homology.
